note.summary:
3.1 Travel and tourism, including places of interest
Key focus
- journeys, holidays, transport, accommodation and attractions.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use appropriate prepositions, contrast completed events with future plans, and sequence a journey with time phrases.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Di solito trascorro le vacanze in montagna perché l’aria è pulita.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I usually spend my holidays in the mountains because the air is clean.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.

questions.question:

questions.modelAnswer: Vorrei alloggiare in un campeggio vicino alla spiaggia.

Translate into Italian:

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: L’anno prossimo viaggeremo in autobus per ridurre il costo del viaggio.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Di solito trascorro le vacanze in montagna perché l’aria è pulita. Siamo partiti alle sei e abbiamo preso il treno per Roma. L’albergo era piccolo, ma la camera aveva vista sul mare. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: I usually spend my holidays in the mountains because the air is clean. We left at six and took the train to Rome. The hotel was small, but the room had a sea view. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)

Write 40–60 words in Italian about travel and tourism, including places of interest (journeys, holidays, transport, accommodation and attractions). You must mention:
• the main person or activity
• your current opinion
• a recent or typical experience
• what you plan for the future

questions.modelAnswer:

(English translation: We left at six and took the train to Rome. The hotel was small, but the room had a sea view. Yesterday we visited an old castle and bought souvenirs. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
